home.intro: Where would you like to start today?

access.title: Account access
access.inactive: This instructor is inactive. Activate them first to change the password or enter their panel.

password.title: Password
password.description: Set a new password when they can’t log in. They are signed out everywhere and get an email about it.
password.dialogDescription: Type a new password, or let us create a strong one. They are signed out everywhere and get an email saying the team changed it.
password.saved: The new password for {name} is saved. We emailed them about it.
password.savedNotEmailed: The new password for {name} is saved, but the email to them couldn’t be sent. Please tell them yourself.

result.title: New password for {name}
result.label: New password (shown only now)
result.once: This is the only time you’ll see it: it can’t be shown again.
result.share: Send it to {name} privately, for example in a direct message, never in a group.
result.emailed: We emailed {name} that the team changed their password. The email doesn’t contain the password.
result.notEmailed: The email to {name} couldn’t be sent, so please tell them yourself.
result.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Please select the password and copy it by hand.

errors.rateLimited: You’ve changed many passwords in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

instructor.title: Their panel
instructor.description: See the instructor panel just as {name} sees it, for up to one hour. Signing contracts isn’t possible while you’re viewing.
instructor.confirmDescription: You’ll see their panel for up to one hour, with a bar at the top. Press End in the bar to come back here. What you change there is recorded under your name.

member.title: Their account
member.description: See the site and the account just as {name} sees them, for up to one hour. Registering for a workshop isn’t possible while you’re viewing.
member.confirmDescription: You’ll see the site as them for up to one hour, with a bar at the top. Press End in the bar to come back here. What you change there is recorded under your name.
